messages:
Priya Shah: Heads up — MarinerPay renewal in ~45 days. We flagged a 66% drop in active seat activity last 30d (420 -> 140). Procurement pinged for cost review and a new ML lead (J. Alvarez) is evaluating alternatives. :warning:
Samir Chen: Yikes. Any signal on why usage dropped? onboarding blocked? API errors?
Priya Shah: No error spike in logs, sentiment from CS survey is ‘slow performance at scale’ and they mentioned latency on long sequences. Procurement mentioned a competitive POC from NimbusServe.
Anika Patel: Can we get a playback of top 10 queries + avg latency per model? I can run a targeted enablement session for power users if it's performance related.
Samir Chen: Quick query I ran (approx):
```
SELECT route, count(*) as calls, avg(latency_ms) as avg_ms
FROM prod.inference_events
WHERE account_id = 'marinerpay' AND ts > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Results show >2x avg latency on /v1/chat for sequences >512 tokens.
Eliot Torres: If it's long-seq latency, we should propose Redwood Optimize tuning: suggest quantization profile + smaller batch windows for that route. That usually shaves 20-40% cost and improves 95p latency.
Priya Shah: Good — I'll surface that in the next call. Also sales wants to know if we can offer a short Dedicated trial (predictable perf) to compare vs NimbusServe. @Jordan Kim (Sales) can you weigh in on discount/zipline availability?
Jordan Kim (Sales): We have a one-month Dedicated trial we can fast-track for strategic renewals. Need commitment to a QBR and exec touch. No heavy discounting unless they commit to a pilot scope. I can offer waived setup fees.
Samir Chen: Operational ask: can infra spin up a 1-node Dedicated pool with model X-3-q4 (quantized) in staging for them this week so they can run their top queries? CSBot: provisioning request created #prov-7891.
CSBot: Provisioning ticket prov-7891 -> assigned to eng-infra oncall. ETA 48 hrs.
Anika Patel: I'll schedule two enablement sessions: 1) power users on prompt/seq best practices; 2) engineering deep-dive with their ML lead. Priya — can you get a time window for next Wed/Thu?
Priya Shah: Reaching out now. Also asking for the NimbusServe POC spec so we can pre-build a side-by-side perf checklist (latency, 95p, cost/token, KV cache hit).
Eliot Torres: One more recommendation — add a short eval suite: 50 synthetic long-seq requests + their top 20 real requests. We'll collect traces and token breakdowns. If we see 95p < target, we can present perf numbers in the QBR.
Jordan Kim (Sales): I'll loop in legal for the trial contract and ask account exec to join QBR.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. Action items: Samir to confirm test node, Anika enablement scheduling, Jordan contract, Eliot eval harness. I'll update thread after first enablement call. :thumbsup:
